## File: facebookresearch_rlmeta/third_party/moolib/src/tensorpipe/third_party/pybind11/tools/mkdoc.py

Prompts

```
['run mkdoc.py on C++ header files to extract Doxygen comments into a C docstring header', 'process_comment converts Doxygen and C++ comment syntax into Markdown-formatted docstrings', 'sanitize_name transforms C++ identifiers including operators into valid Python docstring variable names', 'extract recursively walks a Clang AST to collect documentation from classes, functions, and enums', 'run ExtractionThread to parse multiple C++ header files in parallel using a semaphore-limited thread pool']
```
